name: carousel
useFor: Use to page through a set of similar cards when space is short (matching sites, photos of one site). Give each CarouselItem a basis for how many show at once. Leave room either side for the arrow keys, or place them yourself.
constraints: Dots as the only way to move
Slides of different heights in one row
source: Not in Figma: square keys in the Stone line with the arrow of UI · Buttons (442:3), for a designer's review
title: Carousel
description: A row of slides that snap into place, with square Bone previous and next keys in the 1px Stone line and Mireye's arrow, outside it.
